text:
mina: scheduling a config-only patch for tonight 18:00-19:00 UTC. Changes: routing.default_weight 0.88->0.92, batch_window_ms 20->15, per_tenant_rate_limit 120->100 rps. No model changes. @igor @sre-oncall ack?
deploy-bot: Job queued: config-patch/1799999999. Canary plan: 4% traffic, 15m watch, auto-rollback triggers: 5xx >0.7% or p95 +180ms.
igor: ack. note: per_tenant_rate_limit drop needs comms to partners (might affect high-throughput tenants). can we pin tenants with dedicated capacity to keep 120 rps?
mina: yes will add tenant.pin for dedicated customers to 120 rps. also keeping batch_window at 18ms instead of 15 to be safe.
sre-oncall: 18ms seems safer. I'll add a short-lived alert for rate-limit throttles >0.5%.
deploy-bot: Job updated: config-patch/1799999999.v2. Canary start at 18:00 UTC. Hooks: throttles.alert, p95, 5xx.
mina: planned ramp: 4% -> 20% @18:10 -> 60% @18:30 -> 100% @18:50. manual holds at each step.
deploy-bot: Canary started at 18:00 UTC (1800000005). Streams: https://obs.redwood/internal/streams/1799999999
deploy-bot: 18:08 update: throttles 0.0%, p95 +50ms, 5xx 0.01%.
igor: partners notified. no concerns so far.
sre-oncall: watching for throttles spike during 20% ramp.
deploy-bot: 18:12 traffic 20%. metrics: throttles 0.02%, p95 +63ms, 5xx 0.02%.
mina: proceed to 60%.
deploy-bot: 18:31 traffic 60%. metrics: throttles 0.08%, p95 +92ms, 5xx 0.03%.
sre-oncall: small throttle bump but below alert. continue.
deploy-bot: 18:49 traffic 100%. rollout complete at 18:52 UTC. No rollback triggered.
mina: updating release notes now: "Config patch: tighter default routing weight, reduced batch window to 18ms, reduced default per-tenant RPS to 100 while dedicated tenants remain at 120 RPS (pinned)."
igor: will follow up with partners impacted by RPS change separately.
sre-oncall: create ticket INF-400 to track any throttle escalations.
mina: noted. closing thread.
